1. (Currently amended) A composition comprising:
a) an active ingredient comprising an indole compound of formula I;
b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles; and
c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action;
wherein said composition is suitable for __treatment__ of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation.

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition for __treatment__ of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition for __treatment__ of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, psoriatic rheumatism, skin atopy such as eczema, respiratory atopy, or hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for __treatment of__ hair care and/or hair follicle development.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment of__ the general state of the skin or hair.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for __treatment of__ skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Cancelled)
